name: Dum Biryani Rasoi
description:
Welcome to Dum Biryani Rasoi, a premium cloud kitchen dedicated to the royal art of slow cooking. We bring the authentic flavors of Awadh and Hyderabad directly to your doorstep. Every biryani is handcrafted in small batches using the traditional 'Dum Pukht' method—sealed with dough and slow-cooked to perfection to lock in the rich aromas of whole spices, premium basmati rice, and tender marinated meats.

Beyond our signature biryanis, explore our exquisite menu of rich Indian gravies, smoky kebabs, curries, and comforting thalis. Whether you're craving a deluxe feast for one or ordering in bulk for a gathering, we promise an uncompromising, luxurious culinary experience.

Note: We are a delivery and takeaway-only kitchen.

We recently had dinner at Nakod’s Biryani House, and it turned out to be one of those meals that leaves you fully satisfied and smiling. The place has a warm, welcoming vibe — simple yet cozy, with clean interiors and a homely aroma of freshly cooked food that immediately makes you feel at ease.

We ordered the Chicken Thali and Chicken Biryani, and both dishes impressed us in their own way. The Chicken Thali was truly special — it included tender, flavorful chicken cooked in a perfectly medium spiced gravy, soft chapatis that felt freshly made, and a delicious chicken soup that set the tone for the meal. What made it stand out was their special "Wada" and "Purnur" — both traditional items that they prepare at home during festival times. It added an authentic, festive touch that’s rare to find in regular restaurants. Every bite felt homely and lovingly prepared.

The Chicken Biryani was fragrant, well-balanced, and absolutely delicious. The rice was long-grained and perfectly cooked, each grain carrying the flavor of the spices without being oily or too heavy. The chicken pieces were juicy and generously portioned, blending beautifully with the biryani masala. It had that perfect mix of aroma, taste, and texture that makes you want another serving.

Service was prompt and friendly — the staff was attentive without being intrusive, always ready to help with a smile. The overall atmosphere was relaxed and family-friendly, ideal for both casual dinners and small celebrations.

If you love authentic flavors, warm hospitality, and food made with heart, Nakod’s Biryani House is definitely worth a visit. We’ll surely be going back soon!

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you’ve never tried Saoji cuisine, you’re in for a treat — and there’s no better place to experience it than Nakod’s Biryani House! This hidden gem is lovingly run by a delightful sister-brother duo, whose passion for their native food shines through in every detail. The magic, however, truly begins in the kitchen, where their parents — the heart and soul of the place — cook each dish with pure love, warmth, and authenticity.

We indulged in their Saoji Mutton Thali, Saoji Chicken Thali, Chicken Biryani, and Mutton Biryani, and every dish told a story of rich tradition and bold flavor. The thalis are wonderfully wholesome — complete with generous servings of spicy, flavorful curries, soft chapatis, fragrant rice, comforting soup, refreshing chaas, a touch of sweetness in dessert, and their signature purnur — a unique vada meant to be savored with the Saoji gravy. It’s something you won’t find elsewhere, and it adds a truly authentic touch to the meal.

The biryanis, too, deserve a special mention — aromatic, full-bodied, and perfectly balanced, with every grain of rice infused with flavor. What’s even better is that you can ask to adjust the spice level according to your preference — from mild to authentically fiery.

What truly sets Nakod’s Biryani House apart is how genuine the entire experience feels — from the heartfelt hospitality to the unmistakable home-cooked essence of every bite. Whether you’re a fan of spicy Indian food or simply someone who loves exploring regional cuisines, this place will leave you curious, delighted, and craving more.
A must-visit for anyone who wants to discover the soulful and fiery world of Saoji cuisine!

We had dinner at this outlet in Ramadhan.
If you're around Andheri, Persian Darbar is honestly a must-visit. The decor is beautiful has that royal, slightly old-school charm that makes the whole experience feel special.
The food was the real highlight though. Every dish felt like it was trying to outdo the other in flavour, and somehow nothing disappointed. featured_reviews.name: Nilesh Netke
featured_reviews.review_text:
Serious Food Safety Issue & Request for Accountability

We visited Persian Darbar expecting a good dining experience; however, it resulted in a serious health issue.

We ordered a combination of vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. From the vegetarian items, Paneer Tikka Masala was partially left, packed, and taken home. The next day, all five of us who consumed the food suffered from loose motion, fever, and vomiting. Subsequently, our parents also consumed the same packed food and experienced identical symptoms.

This strongly points toward poor food quality or lack of freshness. Due to this incident:
•	Multiple family members required medical attention
•	We incurred doctor consultation and medication expenses
•	I missed work, and my parents also lost working days
•	We faced significant physical discomfort and mental stress

Dining at a reputed restaurant should create good memories—not lead to health trauma and medical emergencies.

Given the seriousness of this incident, we believe the management should take responsibility and compensate us for the medical expenses, lost workdays, and the distress caused. At the very least, we expect acknowledgment of the issue and assurance of corrective measures to prevent this from happening to other customers.

This review is shared in the interest of consumer awareness and accountability.

Tanjore Tiffin Room, Versova – Authentic South Indian Delight!

Visited **Tanjore Tiffin Room, Versova** on Sunday with a group of 12, and the experience was fantastic!

The **Chicken Ghee Roast, Chicken Chintamani, and Pepper Chicken** were absolutely outstanding - rich, spicy, and packed with authentic South Indian flavors. 🍗🔥
We also loved the **Malabar Parotta, Appam, Idiyappam, and Dosa with Sambar** - soft, fresh, and perfect with the curries.

Veg dishes like **Jackfruit Cutlet and Jackfruit Biryani** were surprisingly delicious, and the **Chicken Biryani** was aromatic and generously portioned. The **Mango Mint Cooler** was a refreshing highlight after the spicy feast. 🥭❄️

If the main seating area is full, they have **additional seating inside WTF**, which is very convenient during peak hours.
They also offer a **tasting platter where the staff explains different curries and how they are used in cooking** - a brilliant concept for first-time visitors and food enthusiasts.

The restaurant is **just ~500 meters from Versova Metro Station**, making it very easy to reach. 🚇

For around **₹9.7K for 12 people (~₹800 per person)**, the quality, quantity, and taste were totally worth it.

**Highly recommended for authentic South Indian food and group outings! Will definitely visit again.**

featured_reviews.name: Sneha Soneji
featured_reviews.review_text:
Deewano da Dhaba or as they call it here, D3 is a place I came across on Zomato. We needed a place for a get together with old friends so decided to visit here as it has pure North Indian Cuisine.

It's located really on the other side of Versova, you have to reach by Google Maps only.

They have NonAc Section outside and the setup is completely Dhaba style with Khatiyas. Inside is Ac section with around 6 tables which has normal restaurant type seating.

I ordered Masala Chaas for myself. Very refreshing, the curd was very fresh.

APPETIZERS

Bharwan Tandoori Aloo :

The most famous dish of theirs in the vegetarian section was their Tandoori Bharwan Aloo so I ordered this as potato is my anytime favorite. The Potato was stuffed with paneer and cheese, and was cooked in tandoor. It was just so delicious.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

Badami Paneer Tikka :

A first time for me, I tried Badami Paneer because my friend ordered it. A lovely almond flavor came as the aftertaste, and they had slivers of almond as garnish too. The paneer was soft and fresh. Loved it.

Paneer Angara Tikka :

Another one of their specialities, Paneer Angara Tikka is their spicy version of the regular paneer tikka. The paneer was really soft and very fresh.

D3 Special Murgh Angara Tikka :

For the chicken, we chose the speciality again. Chicken Tikka was served on a sizzler platter with sizzling fire. The chicken was cooked well, loved the smoky taste and it was spicy too.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

MAIN COURSE

Murgh Lababdar :

Chicken tikka pieces cookes in creamy tomato gravy, along with cheese. I had never tried this dish and I must say, I was too overjoyed. This was just amazing. The tikka pieces still had their tandoori taste, the gravy was deliciously cheesy and creamy. I had it with roomali roti and liked it though i think tandoori roti would have gone better.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

Dal Makhani :

North Indian restaurant and I dont have Dal Makhani, that's not possible. Dal Makhani is my favorite lately and I ordered this along with Steam Rice. It was sooo yummy. The dal was cooked so well, the amount of creaminess was just perfect. I had with roti as well as rice.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

DESSERT

Jalebi Rabdi :

The best Jalebi n Rabdi I have had in recent times. The jalebi was freshly fried in desi ghee and was very crispy. Not too sweet, which was better.
The rabdi was thick and too creamy n tasty, we just couldn't stop eating it.

** HIGHLY RECOMMENDED **

Their delivery radius is around 6-7kms which is more than the other restaurants deliver too, which is a really good thing.

The servers are all happy go lucky and always smiling and readily help with choosing the dishes. Even the owner is a very sweet and down to earth person.

The service is a tad bit slow but only because they have a lot of orders flowing through for delivery and also coz the place was getting full by the night. The crowd really pulled up after 9pm. Food is really value for money. Worth a visit..!!

I am going back for sure..!!

featured_reviews.name: Preetie Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m an old school and rooted person when it comes to food. I love my basics more than the fancy frilly food we get these days. Basics never go wrong and never fail in satisfying one’s palate. Deewano Daa Dhaba stole a piece of my heart the other day. I’m really surprised why there are so many negative reviews posted here when this place really deserves to be among the best ones for North Indian food. I can say this easily that this place probably serves the best quality of paneer in Mumbai.

The place is simple with Ac and non Ac sections. The outside area has the wooden cots for the desi wala feeling while enjoying your meal whereas the inside section is the regular seating. The food we ordered is as follows;

1. Nimbu Pudine ka Sherbat: This is an absolute must try . It’s super refreshing and the flavours are simply perfect. Do not miss this.
2. Bharwan Tandoori Aloo : The stuffing in these aloos was loads of soft paneer and it was a melt in the mouth kind texture. The marination was good but could have been better. The Tandoori punch was slightly missing here. But still this dish was so good.
3. Corn & Cheese seekh Kebab. Super soft & succulent kebabs. Was mild and yet so flavoursome.
4. Paneer Mussalam: An absolute must try here. U just cannot miss this dish here. It’s not just the quality of paneer that won’t my heart but how well they had prepared the gravy to match this quality of paneer is commendable.
5. Dal Makhani. What’s a Punjabi meal without this dal !!! Obviously a must try again. No words to describe my experience…. Simply order it.
6. Tandoori roti and mirchi Dhaniya kulcha. Now the reason I’m mentioning the breads here is bcos they were the regular breads but what made them super special was the liberal dollop of desi white butter served on top of these. It just made me so nostalgic and the taste of our food enhanced almost ten folds due to this. It’s a rare treat to find desi makkhan these days and when u get to relish it with a hearty meal like this then I think Nirvana is achieved 😃
7. Desi Ghee ki Jalebi with Rabdi. Omg is the list of must try not going to stop!!! A definite must try here. Simply wow effect.  The flavour of the desi ghee with the thick laccha rabdi is heavenly. Mild Sweet so the guilt is slightly lesser. 😅

While writing this review I have been salivating and craving to go back again to this place as I can’t control my cravings now. So probably my next meal maybe just here today 😅 This sums up my experience I guess. One more thing that I must mention here is the warm and friendly hospitality of The owner, Mr. Siddhesh Chawla and his wonderful staff.
They were flawless and courteous.

featured_reviews.name: Komal Jaisingh
featured_reviews.review_text:
Located at Off Yari Road, this modern Dhaba is the place you need to go!! Serving delicious vegetarian and Non Vegetarian North Indian food, Dewano da Dhaba is living up to its name! The have AC as well as Non AC ambience.. and a great place to hangout with family and friends! The owner, Siddesh Chawla was really friendly and made sure all his guests were comfortable... The service was good and staff was courteous.. Ravi and Jagbandu served us well!!
Talking about the food we had... We had some refreshing Mocktails .. Blue eyes, Virgin Mojito, Virgin Mojito Cranberry and fresh lime soda!! Would highly recommend Blue eyes and Virgin Mojito Cranberry..
Also had some mouthwatering starters like Paneer Angara which came on a hot sizzling platter.. And had Murgh Cheese Achari Tikka which was drooling.. both these starters made our day!!
Coming to the main course.. we had Paneer Lababdar which was great in quantity and Mutton Korma which was amazing and perfect for mutton lovers!! Also would suggest The yummy Kulcha !!
Well there is always a room for desserts.. We tried the Malpura Rabdi.. I tried Malpura for the very first time and I have to say it that I really liked it.. the crispiness of Malpura and the sweet Rabdi made a superb combination together..

Overall this place is a must go to satisfy all your food cravings!

featured_reviews.name: nitin seth
featured_reviews.review_text:

Very Disappointing Experience at Bonfire
The food was good, but unfortunately everything else was disappointing.
To my surprise, the restaurant operates almost entirely on self-service despite charging premium prices. The service staff lacked basic menu knowledge. We ordered Chicken Fried Rice for a child, and it was served with a sachet/bowl of Ching's Schezwan Sauce, a packaged product easily available in any grocery store.
When we asked the female server whether the sauce was made in-house, she confidently said it was. Later, we asked a male server the same question, and he honestly admitted that it was Ching's Schezwan Sauce. The contradictory answers clearly showed a lack of staff training and product knowledge.
To make matters worse, we ordered an LIT (Long Island Iced Tea) cocktail and found a cockroach in it. This is completely unacceptable and raises serious concerns about hygiene standards.
Overall:
Food quality: Good
Service: Very poor
Staff knowledge: Poor
Hygiene: Unacceptable
Portion size: Small
Pricing: Expensive for what is offered
Good food alone cannot compensate for poor service, lack of transparency, and serious hygiene issues. Finding a cockroach in a cocktail completely ruined the experience.
Would not recommend until major improvements are made in service, staff training, and cleanliness.

featured_reviews.name: Benjamin SHIH
featured_reviews.review_text:
This is my first time visiting India, and I’m so glad we found this gem. The Owner/Chef is incredibly welcoming; he personally helped us order and explained the flavors with such passion.
We are from Taiwan and have tried many top-tier Indian restaurants back home, like Saffron (番紅花), Taj (泰姬), and Mayur (馬友友). But the Gosht Lucknowi Dum Biryani here is on a whole different level. My friend even said it’s 10 times better!
• The Mutton: I’ve never had mutton this tender. It’s perfectly marinated and practically falls apart. You can really taste the "Kung Fu" the Chef puts into the slow-cooking.
• The Sauce: That rich, golden gravy isn't just a sauce; it's a concentration of slow-cooked onions and spices that melt in your mouth.
• The Pro Move: Make sure to mix in the spicy yogurt raita. It cuts through the richness and adds a whole new layer of flavor to the fragrant rice.
If you want a meal made with genuine heart and soul, this is the place. A huge thank you to the Chef for such a warm welcome to India!

featured_reviews.name: shraddha nabar
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely loved the food at The Bombay Curry!

For the 1st time we saw a chef personally taking orders and preparing them for us. We were already in heaven. The moment came when food was served it was mind blowing.

We had chicken Angara , Chicken Malai kebab, Luckowi Murgh Makhani, Dhaniwal Korma & Hyderabadi dum biryani.
I absolutely loved the chicken angara starter. Easily one of the best, juiciest and most succulent chicken I’ve ever had. Not to forget the Hyderabad biryani and Dhaniwal Korma Soooo good!

Also had a lovely conversation with Chef Kunal Nagpal and got to know about his story and how he started the restaurant.
Food, ambience, staff-  Awesome, definitely recommended

featured_reviews.review_text:
A very popular kebab & biryani restaurant just next to Khar station West.
It is very small joint with about five small tables.
It is air-conditioned but a little cramped to sit.
If tables are occupied then be prepared to wait for a table.
Service is also a bit slow as everything is freshly prepared after order is taken.
Food is their positive point.
The owner is friendly & sitting at counter.
The chef moves around & takes the order.
We tried chicken raezala kebabs which were fresh & tasty with tandoori rotis.
Also tried the gohst Lucknowi dum biryani which was also good but taste was not as per our expectations.
On the whole a good place to visit if in Khar area.

featured_reviews.name: Sunny Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our first meal in Mumbai turned out to be an absolute gem! 🍽️
We visited a small restaurant with a cozy sitting area that can accommodate around 10 people, but the food was truly 1001%.

We started with two types of kebabs — super tasty, juicy, and full of flavor 🤤. Then came the curry with fresh naan, and everything was prepared fresh and served hot. You can really taste the quality and effort in every bite.

Small place, big flavors! 💯
Really enjoyed our first meal in Mumbai and would definitely recommend this hidden gem to anyone looking for authentic, freshly prepared food.

featured_reviews.name: Shreeya Mehrotra
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’m a North Indian living in Mumbai, and everyone knows that Mumbai doesn’t really do good North Indian food unless it’s fancy. Most days you just adjust, but some days you really miss proper food. That’s exactly the kind of day I found Bombay Curry and honestly I’m so glad I did. This place feels so homely. It’s the kind of place you go to on a random night when you’ve had a bad day, you’re tired and you just want something that feels like home.

We ordered butter chicken, garlic naan and seekh kebab and every single thing was a straight 10/10. The butter chicken was rich and comforting, the garlic naan was soft and perfect and the seekh kebabs were juicy and full of flavour.

What makes it even more special is knowing that the chefs are from Lucknow and Rajasthan because you can genuinely taste that authenticity in the food. And the chef/owner himself was easily one of the most friendly and nicest chefs I’ve ever met. Warm, welcoming and clearly cooking with a lot of love. Bombay Curry feels like a hug on a plate.

featured_reviews.name: Sagar “Sagar Anil” A
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience was an 80–20 mix, but overall quite memorable. We’ve visited multiple restaurants across Mumbai and often seen chefs deeply occupied with their cooking schedules. Here, however, we met Chef Kunal Nagpal—a chef with a story, beautifully balancing restaurant management and creating magic with his food.

We reached the hotel around 3:45 PM, just before closing time, which meant our order was taken in a bit of a hurry. We patiently waited for the food, and that’s where the experience truly took a turn for the better.

We ordered Chicken Malai Tikka and Butter Chicken, and both dishes were outstanding. The masala was rich and delicious. A special recommendation: do try their Chicken Malai Tikka—it’s a must!

Overall rating: 8/10. If you’re a fan of Mughlai chicken, this restaurant is definitely worth a visit.

Chef, we wish you continued success and all the best for your future endeavours.

Thank you,
Sagar & Tejashree

featured_reviews.name: Sadhana Viswanadhuni
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a true Hyderabadi my search for such amazing biryani never ends! I hated mumbai for not having it here! But now I don't need to look any further😍😍😍
Biryani By Kilo's biryani are sooo hyderabadi in taste that one is definitely going to have a foodgasm!❤️
My search ends here today as now I'm gonna keep ordering from BBK to satisfy my biryani cravings 😍😍 We ordered for
Paneer Nawabi Curry ✨
A delectable paneer dish! The gravy was very smooth with the right amount of spices and softtt paneer 😍
Ulte Tawa ka Parantha ✨
It's like a thicker smaller version of rumali roti but much better than that! As we ordered the food earlier we heated it up on tawa and savoured it with the paneer curry 😍
Veg Hyderabadi Biryani ✨
A properly packed flavoured rice with amazingly marinated veggies! The masalas were right and yummm. What more?? They even serve it with SALAN like in Hyderabad!!!!! 😍😍😍💞
Veg Kathal Dum Biryani ✨ - MUST HAVE!!!!!!!
This delicacy of south is a seasonal favourite and I was very doubtful if it would match to my expectations and mind me it was way beyond that! It had the perfect taste like we get it back in south!
And it was a super hit with all my family members!
😍😍😍
The biryanis were served with
Onion and lemon salad
Salan and Raita too❤️

Coming to the packaging can you think of any other better eco friendly packaging?? To top it off they even provided us with an aanch lighting which allows one to place the pot on candle burner! Which is sure to keep the handi and rice in it warm and fresh😍😍😍

If the green dough sealing gets hard and tough to remove! Don't hesitate to take help of a knife! That part might be tricky but I think a good sealed bowl is very important for perfect biryani 😍🤤🤤

So happy to have stumbled upon this brand! Forever thankful for bringing Hyderabadi Biryani to Mumbai 😍😍😍😍😍😍😍

featured_reviews.name: Rajat Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text:
Biryani by Kilo is one of safest and trusted brand delivering quality biryanis to our doorstep.
Last Thursday we ordered some of the dishes from there. The best thing about them was they deliver biryanis in earthen pots.
Delivery was quick and on time.
The dishes we tried were :

1) Hyderabadi Chicken Biryani (5/5) : Served in a earthen pot with live heating candles. The rice was cooked well. Chicken pieces were perfectly coojed in spices. Overall the biryani was awesome.
Salan and raita was complementary with the biryani was so good.

2) Chicken Korma (5/5) : It was lil sweet as I love. Chicken cooked in thick gravy had lipsmacking flavours. It was also packed in earthern pot.

3) Ulte Tawa ka Paratha (5/5) : It was just perfect. I was trying this first time and really love it.

All the dishes were scrumptious and enough for 3 people .
Hygine and stromg packing was done to avoid spillage and contamination.
Proper safety checks were done.

They made my day, surely gonna order them again.

featured_reviews.name: Foodie Kudi ke Chatake
featured_reviews.review_text: Are you a biryani lover ? If yes then Biryani by kilo is what you should try must. Very impressed with their matka packing which is being offered with candle and a mud pot to heat thir biryani before having it. Secondly packing was excellent and food delivered was peeping hot. Also there is a chutney served along with biryani which is a perfect combination to have with their biryani. Paneer nawabi was good in taste specially the paneer pieces were very soft. Overall a good first experience with them. Will surely try their other varieties in Biryani specially.

featured_reviews.name: Priyanka Kwatra
featured_reviews.review_text:
Best Biryani ever! I love Biryani by Kilo. They have the longest, most flavourful rice in their Biryani. We love their Hyderabadi Biryani the most. It is spicy and made in masalas. It comes with delicious salan, onions and green chutney. The chicken in the biryani is nice and juicy and quantity is also quite good. The handi has to be heated for 5-7 mins before having it. It is Highly recommended to do so as it gives steamy hot well done rice in your plate and it feels we are at a restaurant.
We also had chicken korma with ulta tawa parathas. Korma was also delicious and had quite authentic taste and flavor. The paratha when heated on tawa became nice and flaky. Suggest you to do the same but not too much as it becomes too crisp.
Overall Excellent food delivery and always trustworthy for the taste and flavor. Value for money!

What really stands out is the quality. You can tell this is premium, the aroma of pure ghee and saffron is so rich and authentic. Usually, in veg biryanis, the veggies can feel bland, but here, every piece of cauliflower, aloo, and bean is packed with masala. It’s flavour in every single bite! 😋

Sharing good food is a love language, so if you’re in Mumbai (or traveling from there), you have to try this. I’m definitely ordering this for my friends!

featured_reviews.name: Rahil Kotadia
featured_reviews.review_text:
This place by the Bawa Hotels Group is a good option if you’re in the mood for Punjabi food, just don’t walk in expecting completely authentic flavours. The taste is slightly toned down, but if you set your expectations right, you’ll actually enjoy the food.

The menu is quite well done, and the meal box options are a big plus. Makes ordering super easy without having to overthink or pick too many individual items.

Their parathas are definitely worth trying—served nicely with curd. Do ask for white butter separately though, as it’s not given by default and really makes a difference. The lassi is a must-have here, easily one of the better things on the menu.

Also, a special mention for the Kalimiri chicken shorba. It’s not on the menu, but if they have it, don’t miss it—it’s genuinely very good.

Ambience is nice and comfortable, so no complaints there. Service, however, is quite slow and needs serious improvement, which can get a bit frustrating.

Parking is another issue—since it’s close to the railway station, the area is always crowded and finding a spot is tough. Better to plan that in advance.

Overall, a good place to chill and enjoy a meal, as long as you’re okay overlooking the service and parking hassles.

Got some Jal Jeera with soda to wash it down (not sure about the boondi). Finished off with some Gulabjamun - there is definitely a hint of “Gulab” there! And just look at those soft, pillowy, inviting mounds. 😆

Overall Bawa Kitchen echoes the punjabi ethos when it comes to food. It’s definitely a place I’d recommend and visit again!
